app_identity.name: ProFinance Interior
app_identity.tagline: Aplikasi Catatan Keuangan & Manajemen Proyek Kontraktor Interior & Arsitektur
app_identity.target_audience: Kontraktor Interior, Arsitek Studio, Pemborong Bangunan, Project Manager Interior di Indonesia

design_system.theme_mode: Dual theme support with warm editorial slate default (Light theme default for architectural trust, with high contrast dark mode toggle)

typography.heading_font: Outfit, sans-serif (Architectural geometric precision, clean weight scaling)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Indonesian SaaS standard, clean legibility at high density)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (Numeric currency accuracy, transaction tables, S-Curve coordinates)

brand_primary.description: Warm Wood Teak & Amber Brass - symbolizes high-end carpentry, timber & architectural craftsmanship

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous interior padding (p-4 to p-8) with clear nested radii (rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for subcomponents)
layout_strategy.card_style: 1px crisp border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800) with subtle ambient drop shadow (shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow)
layout_strategy.navigation: Top Header with Sticky Blur + Quick Tenant Switcher (Free / Premium Tier Badge) + Navigation Tabs/Pills

key_features_and_pages.design_notes: Dual method: 'Masuk dengan Google' prominent CTA button + Email/Password form. Includes a visual preview showcase of interior project financial metrics on the left side (or top in mobile).

key_elements: KPI Aggregated Cards: Total Saldo Bersih, Total Budget Proyek, Total Sisa Tagihan (Accounts Receivable), Total Kasbon Tukang Aktif
Multi-Tenant / Freemium Status Banner: Displays Plan status (Free vs Premium) with quick upgrade button
Project Cards Grid: Filterable by Status (Semua, Berjalan, Selesai, Pending) with Financial Health Indicator badge (#16a34a, #2563eb, #d97706, #ea580c, #dc2626)
Modal Tambah Proyek Baru (Nama Proyek, Klien, Nilai Kontrak Rp, Tenggat Waktu, Kategori Interior: Residensial, Komersial, Kantor)

tabs.name: Cash Flow
tabs.description: Tabel Transaksi Masuk (Pemasukan/Termyn Klien) & Keluar (Bahan, Tukang, Operasional). Modal Tambah Transaksi dengan opsi Upload Foto Struk/Nota Bukti Transfer.

tabs.name: Kasbon & Tukang
tabs.description: Daftar Pekerja/Tukang, Tarif Harian/Borongan, Akumulasi Kasbon, dan Status Pelunasan Upah (Lunas / Ada Tunggakan). Quick Action 'Bayar Kasbon' & 'Pelunasan Upah'.

tabs.name: Progress Pekerjaan
tabs.description: Tracking item pekerjaan (e.g. Pekerjaan Plafon, Finishing HPL, Installasi Listrik) + Grafis Kurva-S (S-Curve Chart: Rencana vs Realisasi %). Memiliki Paywall Overlay untuk pengguna Free Tier dengan preview blurred backdrop & CTA Upgrade Premium.

tabs.name: Laporan & Analytics
tabs.description: Visualisasi Pie Chart (Breakdown Pengeluaran per Kategori) + Horizontal Bar Chart (Margin Perbandingan Pemasukan vs Pengeluaran). Tombol Export Laporan PDF (Clean Printable Layout). Memiliki Paywall Overlay untuk pengguna Free Tier.

key_elements: Perbandingan Paket Free vs Premium Pro (Rp 149.000 / bulan atau Rp 1.290.000 / tahun)
Mockup Payment Modal: Simulasi pembayaran via QRIS, Transfer Bank BCA/Mandiri, atau E-Wallet (OVO/Gopay) untuk instan unlock fitur Premium SaaS.

testing_and_qa_guidelines.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, inputs, modals, buttons, financial metrics, and tab triggers MUST contain descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, highly interactive single-page application (SPA) with React Router, Framer Motion, and Lucide React icons.
Implement state persistence using localStorage so user data (projects, cash flow transactions, workers/tukang, user tier status: Free vs Premium) persists during browser refresh.

Provide seed mock data representing real Indonesian interior contractor projects (e.g., 'Kitchen Set & Wall Panel Villa Canggu', 'Fitout Office Tower SCBD', 'Renovasi Rumah Cluster Bintaro') with initial transaction records, tukang data, and progress percentages.
Ensure strict adherence to the mandated financial health indicator color coding hex values: >=20% (#16a34a), 10-19% (#2563eb), 0-9% (#d97706), -10 to -1% (#ea580c), <-10% (#dc2626).
Format all money values in Indonesian Rupiah (e.g. Rp 145.000.000) with proper dot digit separation.

For the Progress and Report tabs in Project Detail, if the user is currently on the Free Tier, render a high-end Paywall Banner overlay with a blurred background preview, listing Premium features and a direct 'Upgrade ke Premium' CTA button that opens the Pricing / Mockup Payment dialog.
Provide a header toggle to instantly switch between Free and Premium account modes for easy testing and demonstration of paywall unlocking.
Ensure PDF export generates a clean, printable summary (or print dialog view) with company header, project details, cash flow summary, and charts.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or header elements; always use proper solid or backdrop-blur backgrounds.
